Large-scale generative language models such as GPT-3 are competitive few-shot learners. arxiv-2401-07456.title: Only Send What You Need: Learning to Communicate Efficiently in Federated Multilingual Machine Translation
arxiv-2401-07456.creator: Yun-Wei Chu, Dong-Jun Han, Christopher G. Brinton
arxiv-2401-07456.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) is a promising distributed machine learning paradigm that enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a global model. In this paper, we focus on a practical federated multilingual learning setup where clients with their own language-specific data aim to collaboratively construct a high-quality neural machine translation (NMT) model.
